messages.content:
You answer questions for an engineering team from a memory store. The user message holds the memory you may use, then the question.
Rules:
- Answer only from the memory provided. Do not use outside knowledge and do not guess.
- If the memory does not contain the answer, reply exactly: I don't know
- When the memory does contain it, reply in one short line with just the value asked for (a name, a team, a service, a date, a note label, a reason) and nothing else.
- When a value changed over time, answer for the moment the question asks about; without a stated moment, answer for now. Today is 2026-06-30.
- Memory entries carry the date they were recorded. Treat a later entry as superseding an earlier one on the same subject.

Memory:
- The billing API is owned by the Ember team as of 2026-01-12, having moved from the Atlas team. [decision; valid 2026-01-12 to now; recorded by handover/2026-01-12-billing-api]
- The billing API was owned by the Atlas team from 2025-06-09, having moved from the Ember team, until ownership transferred to the Ember team on 2026-01-12. [decision; valid 2026-01-12 to now; recorded by handover/2026-01-12-billing-api]
    earlier: The billing API is owned by the Atlas team as of 2025-06-09, having moved from the Ember team; the Boreal team was recorded by mistake and never held it. [valid 2025-07-03 to 2026-01-12; recorded by handover/2025-07-03-billing-api-correction]
    earlier: The billing API is owned by the Boreal team as of 2025-06-09, having moved from the Ember team. [valid 2025-06-09 to 2025-07-03; recorded by handover/2025-06-09-billing-api]
    earlier: The billing API is owned by the Ember team as of 2025-03-07. [valid 2025-03-07 to 2025-06-09; recorded by handover/2025-03-07-billing-api]
    earlier: The billing API is owned by the Atlas team. [valid 2025-01-08 to 2025-03-07; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-01-08-2]
- The billing API only ships on weekdays after 15:00 UTC. [constraint; valid 2025-02-11 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-02-11]
- The billing API depends on the ledger service for invoice postings. [valid 2025-01-09 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-01-09-2]
- As of 2025-11-11, the billing API has a deploy freeze from 2025-11-24 to 2025-12-02 for the peak season. [constraint; valid 2025-11-11 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-11-11]
- On 2026-03-11 the Cinder team noticed that the billing API's cold start time tripled after the runtime upgrade and pinged the owners. [valid 2026-03-11 to now; recorded by standup/cinder/2026-03-11-2]
- Changes to the billing API need a rollback plan attached to the pull request. [constraint; valid 2025-04-02 to now; recorded by standup/ember/2025-04-02]
- On 2025-06-09 Oskar wrote the billing API handover doc for Lena. [valid 2025-06-09 to now; recorded by handover/2025-06-09-billing-api]
- On 2025-12-01 the Boreal team noticed that the billing API's error rate crept up to 2 percent after the dependency bump. [valid 2025-12-01 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-12-01]
- On 2025-11-04 the Ember team saw that the billing API's queue depth hit 50,000 following the marketing send and flagged it because it is not their service. [valid 2025-11-04 to now; recorded by standup/ember/2025-11-04]
- As of 2025-09-30, the billing API gates the new invoice flow behind the feature-flags service because the rollout needs a per-tenant kill switch. [decision; valid 2025-09-30 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-09-30]
- Priya Raman holds the first on-call rotation for the Atlas team as of 2025-07-30. [valid 2025-07-30 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-07-30]
    earlier: Tomasz has the first on-call rotation for the Atlas team. [valid 2025-01-09 to 2025-07-30; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-01-09]
- As of 2025-07-30, Priya Raman holds the Atlas team on-call rotation, taking over from Tomasz. [valid 2025-07-30 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-07-30]
    earlier: Tomasz is on the Atlas team on-call rotation as of 2025-06-19, taking over from Priya Raman. [valid 2025-06-19 to 2025-07-30; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-06-19]
    earlier: Priya Raman is on the Atlas team on-call rotation as of 2025-05-13, taking over from Tomasz. [valid 2025-05-13 to 2025-06-19; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-05-13]
    earlier: Tomasz is on the Atlas team on-call rotation as of 2025-04-03. [valid 2025-04-03 to 2025-05-13; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-04-03]
    earlier: Tomasz is off the Atlas team on-call rotation as of 2025-02-12. [valid 2025-02-12 to 2025-04-03; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-02-12]
- As of 2026-05-29, Oskar is on the Ember team on-call rotation as the primary on-call. [valid 2026-05-29 to now; recorded by standup/ember/2026-05-29]
    earlier: As of 2026-01-15, Oskar is off the Ember team on-call rotation. [valid 2026-01-15 to 2026-05-29; recorded by standup/ember/2026-01-15]
- The ledger service is owned by the Atlas team. [valid 2025-01-08 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-01-08]
- As of 2026-05-29, Oskar is the primary on-call for the Ember team, taking over from Diego. [valid 2026-05-29 to now; recorded by standup/ember/2026-05-29]
    earlier: As of 2026-01-15, Diego is the primary on-call for the Ember team. [valid 2026-01-15 to 2026-05-29; recorded by standup/ember/2026-01-15]
- As of 2026-04-01, the pager for the indexer rings the Boreal team, not the Atlas team. [valid 2026-04-01 to now; recorded by handover/2026-04-01-search-indexer]

Question: Who is on call for the team that owns billing-api?

message.reasoning:
The billing API is owned by the Ember team as of 2026-01-12 (current). The Ember team's primary on-call as of 2026-05-29 is Oskar.

Answer: Oskar.
